newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Weekly flights to link Cairo, Lisbon from July.
newsitem.headline: Weekly flights to link Cairo, Lisbon from July.

text.p: Egyptian private carrier Heliopolis Airlines will begin operating weekly charter flights between Cairo and Lisbon next month, the first direct air link between the two countries, an Egyptian embassy spokesman said.
Commercial Counsellor Mongi Badr told Reuters that Heliopolis, one of three private Egyptian carriers, would begin the service on July 15, using 162-seat McDonnell Douglas MD-83 aircraft.
He said flights would arrive in Lisbon every Tuesday afternoon and return to Cairo the same evening.
The flights are scheduled to run for an initial two-month period until September 15, and beyond if there is sufficient demand.
The spokesman said the flights were expected to boost the flow of tourists and business people between the two countries.
He said Heliopolis Airlines was the largest of the private airlines permitted to operate in Egypt since the airlines market was liberalised there earlier this year.
